#             (content type, signing time, message digest, Apple's hash-agility attributes) and the RSA signature. No private
#             key, credential, token, session identifier or API key identifier is in this file.
#   Use:      regression fixtures of tool/test_verify_ipa.sh (section "real Apple cloud-signing CMS"): the cdhashes attribute
#             of every one of these starts with `<!DOCTYPE plist` and has NO XML declaration, which Python's plistlib
#             automatic format detection rejects (the defect corrected in Phase 1 of the verifier repair).
# FORMAT: one line per signature:  <path inside Runner.app> <SHA-256 of the DER> <base64 of the DER>
